Mitsui and Mitsubishi hold their share in the project through the 50/50 joint venture Japan Australia LNG. 2022, bp expected FID to be taken on the project in 2025. Nov 2023, Shell sold its stake in the project to bp.
_raw.End_: NWS LNG facility, Karratha, WA,  Australia

name: Scarborough Export Pipeline
end_loc: NWS LNG facility, Karratha, WA, Australia
description: The Scarborough Export Pipeline would bring gas from the offshore Scarborough gas field onshore to the Burrup peninsula and the Woodside operated and owned (90%) Pluto LNG facility and potentially to the Karatha gas plant. Woodside is developing the Scarborough gas resource. As of March 2023 expects to be able to ship a first LNG cargo in 2026.
report_citation: GulfPub PE World Map, gas, scraped 2025-12-11

_raw.About: Pipeline license WA-PL-32. Woodside expects to produce 8m t/y of LNG from gas shipped via the Scarborough Export Pipeline. Sumitomo and Sojitz acquired a stake in the project in Aug 2023 through their 50/50 JV LNG Japan. Saipem completed installation of the Scarborough field gas export trunkline in Q4 2024. No further update February 2025.
_raw.End_: NWS LNG facility, Karratha, WA, Australia
